networkAccess.reasoning: api.popnow.ai is PopNow: sign-in, prices, creations and the upload window for the selected layer. connect.popnow.ai hands the sign-in code back to the plugin (it never sees a token). *.r2.cloudflarestorage.com and media.popnow.ai are PopNow's storage: the selected layer is uploaded to a signed address there, and finished images and videos are downloaded from there to place them on the canvas. fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com load the Gabarito font for the panel.
